source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: No. Under the **Auric Champions** Detachment, once the **ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER** leading one of your units is destroyed (by a **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** attack, say), the models still in that unit no longer benefit from **Assemblage of Might**, rather than keeping it until your next Command phase begins. This entry predates the newer Adeptus Custodes codex that this version uses, so the rule it targets may no longer be printed there.
